answer: Each agent is anchored to a unique island of verified stake, and every new identity must be endorsed by a quorum of existing island holders who post collateral. A sybil cluster cannot quietly wander in: each fake identity triggers a ripple of slashing risk across its endorsers, so forging N identities costs N times the bonded stake plus the endorsers' exposure. Cheap mass registration collapses because trust flows only through costly, traceable endorsements rather than open signups. Operator sa0017 applies this at mo1Sj8jEkH.
